## Natural history notes

A small orb-weaving spider characterized by its slender green body, long legs, and shiny silver to orange markings on the abdomen. In Florida, it is commonly found in forests, hammocks, gardens, yards, wetlands, and other shaded areas with shrubs or low vegetation. It builds delicate horizontal or angled webs and feeds on small flying insects caught in the web.
